in_sanskrit.name: चलव्रत
in_sanskrit.meaning: Active, Dynamic, or Wearer of a Chala (cloth)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Chalavrat is derived from the Sanskrit words 'chala' meaning 'cloth' and 'vrata' meaning 'vow' or 'promise'. The name suggests someone who is actively engaged in keeping their promises or vows, and wears the symbol of their commitment in the form of a cloth or chala.

in_hindi.name: चलव्रत
in_hindi.meaning: चलानामापन (chalanaamapaan) - चलाना (chalana) meaning 'to move' and मापन (maapan) meaning 'wearer' or 'bearer'
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Chalavrat in Hindi can be interpreted as 'the wearer of movement' or 'the bearer of motion'. This name is suggestive of someone who is always on the go, constantly active and engaged in various activities.

in_tamil.name: சலவ்ரத்
in_tamil.meaning: சலவும் உள்ளவன் (salavum ulavan) - சலவும் (salavum) meaning 'moving' and உள்ளவன் (ulavan) meaning 'lord' or 'master'
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Chalavrat in Tamil can be translated as 'the lord of movement' or 'the master of motion'. This name is suggestive of someone who has control over their actions and movements, and is in charge of their own destiny.

in_telugu.name: చలవ్రద్
in_telugu.meaning: చలపు బరేది (chalapu baredi) - చలపు (chalapu) meaning 'movement' and బరేది (baredi) meaning 'possessor'
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Chalavrat in Telugu can be interpreted as 'the possessor of movement' or 'the one who has control over their actions and movements'. This name is suggestive of someone who is dynamic and agile, able to adapt to changing circumstances and situations.

in_marathi.name: Chalavrat
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who holds the plow
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chalavrat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Chal’ which means ‘to hold’ and ‘Vrat’ which means ‘plow’. Chalavrat is the name of a warrior or farmer who holds the plow and works diligently in the fields.
